fusions.name: End of the Tether
fusions.desc: Flings a length of links that deals 18 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles, and leaves the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Down the Line
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, then passes on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Dragged to the Dais
fusions.desc: Hauls up to 5 enemies within 7 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Link to Link
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, a link lashes the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 6 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Once every 5 seconds.
